name: Model Turnkey: Qwen3.6-27B NVFP4 (1x Blackwell)
readme: Lower-cost development profile for nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4. Deploy on 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell or GeForce RTX 5090. The profile downloads about 21 GiB, defaults to a 32K text-only context, disables DRAM KV offload and MTP until explicitly tested, and mounts persistent storage at /workspace. Port 8000 is the API, 1111 is the token-gated dashboard, and 22 is key-only SSH. Use an SSH tunnel for requests longer than Runpod proxy's 100-second limit.
